verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at speakeasy.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown-rendered docs pages (ai-control-plane.md). Speakeasy also publishes an agents.md with agent-ready install instructions. Together these give agents several machine-readable entry points to the docs. Missing for 10: evidence of how complete the llms.txt content is (only a header snippet was captured) and any independent user corroboration of agents consuming these docs successfully.
